limitations: Reference footprints are actual paired-block unions, not hulls.
These are reference-only counterfactual placements, not full formal admission propagation.
No independent truth assembly; zero surviving-anchor conflict does not prove no biological cross-subgenome misplacement.
Flye A/B/D name labels are flags, not ground truth.
Original identity/competition/complexity/MAPQ/collinearity gates remain; central-99% trimming is not used for admission.
The interval chain is conservative about overlapping anchors and does not certify global optimum.
Dominant90 additionally requires the local chain to retain at least 90% of its region group support.
The all-locus conflict union includes inferior-hit conflicts; each retained anchor still passed its own original identity-margin mask.
Worker completion order is not scientific candidate order; subsequent selection must sort candidate placements deterministically.

policy.carried_sequence: anchor hull may bridge unsupported sequence and overlap the all-locus conflict union; that union includes conflicts rejected only for weaker hits, not a veto on stronger qualifying anchors
policy.chain: maximum weighted source-disjoint exact collinear actual anchors
policy.conflict_rule: split source intervals at all surviving foreign chr/strand anchors
